contexts.text: Whatever is insinuated into the memory of the external man...
Innocence was insinuated by the Lord into the proprium. Treated of. AC 1043.
It was insinuated into me, that... It was also insinuated that...
It is insinuated into him, that...
Remains... are insinuated as it were by stealth among so many evils and falsities.
Nothing scientific or rational is ever insinuated into man, except by means of good and delight.
Shame is insinuated into him.
They could insinuate themselves into the cupidities and pleasures of others...
In him particulars, and the singulars of particulars, can be insinuated.
Innumerable Falsities... insinuate themselves.
The idea itself of the Infinite Divine is insinuated into the Angels by this...
The first truth that was insinuated into the Lord when a child. Signified.
This sensuous truth is not insinuated, except with the celestial man.
These celestial things are insinuated into man especially (from infancy to childhood); and indeed without Knowledges... These are remains... which are insinuated by the Lord...
To this end the Lord insinuates the delight in knowledges which he perceives in childhood and adolescence.
A fit vessel into which what is celestial can be insinuated.
The will is formed... by insinuated innocence, and charity...
Into His Knowledges as receptacles were constantly insinuated celestial things... For... the celestial things which are of love, are insinuated from the first infancy up to... adolescence...
In proportion as they are purified, the celestial things of love are insinuated into the exterior man.
They who are malignant and deceitful, insinuate themselves into the loves themselves...
It can be insinuated into them, that all things are from the Lord.
The Knowledges which are insinuated through sensuous things.
By scientifics and Knowledges insinuated through the senses...
The Lord... expelled the evil which... had insinuated itself into this first Rational.
This freedom is from the Lord, who insinuates it into his conscience.
(Women who) insinuate themselves by external things...
When charity and innocence are insinuated (into this truth of conscience) by the Lord...
The more truth there is insinuated, the more the life of charity is perfected.
Into these delights... spiritual good is insinuated by the Lord.
Then, from things not understood, fallacies have insinuated themselves.
New ideas are (then) insinuated.
All the good and truth which the Lord insinuates with man, from infancy...
How the Angels... insinuated into the their tender... ideas the sense of the things contained in the Lord's Prayer.
How all things are insinuated into (the infants) by means of delightful and pleasant things...
The goods of innocence and charity which are continually being insinuated by the Lord into these delights and pleasantnesses.
Thus intelligence is insinuated into them by degrees.
By continually insinuating good ends...
It is at once insinuated by the Angels... that they are not in good...
The truth of the Rational is acquired through knowledges... which are insinuated through external and internal sensuous things...
By the things in this chapter it is insinuated how the Lord cast out the human from the mother.
Innocence is thus insinuated into (the Gentiles), and also charity...
Man is prepared by the Lord by this, that such things are insinuated into him as may serve for ground...
(The adulterers) sought where there were houses into which they might insinuate themselves.
(These seducers) insinuate themselves by cunning methods...
The good of life... is insinuated by the Lord through an internal way, quite unawares to the man; but the truth of doctrine through an external way...
In freedom is insinuated the affection of good and truth. AC 2877.
The Angels consider man as their brother, and insinuate into him affections of good and truth.
After they have been regenerated, the Knowledge is by degrees insinuated into them, that...
The good of faith... is at the same time insinuated into him, but so that he scarcely knows it.
Thus is truth insinuated into good... for a man imbues the good of life according to the truth which has been insinuated.
Man is regenerated according to the quality and quantity of the truth which has been insinuated into good.
By this (external) way must truth be insinuated and be implanted in his memory.
Good... adopts the truths which have been insinuated through the sensuous things of the external man.
Insinuates into him a heavenly proprium.
His concupiscences are to be extirpated, and heavenly affections are to be insinuated.
Thus good together with truths insinuates itself from the intellectual part into the voluntary.
The goods and truths which are insinuated through middle good.
Torn is predicated of the good into which falsity is insinuated.
Natural good and its truths are the first things which are insinuated into man...
Are insinuated through the hearing or the sight.
The first insinuation of the affections of truth together with the acquired truths. Signified.
The reason Jabbok = the first insinuation, is...
By which the man who is being regenerated is insinuated into good.
Further insinuation. Signified.
The state of truth when insinuated into good. Signified, Explained.
Man does not even know that there is any insinuation...
General truths into which (genuine truths) can be insinuated.
The insinuation of the good of truth into Divine natural good. Treated of.
As man advances in age, he insinuates particulars into the generals of infancy; and afterwards, singulars into particulars.
The general affections with their truths are first insinuated into good; then the less general ones... and finally the still less general ones. Treated of.
(Examples of truths which are to be insinuated into good.)
This truth cannot be insinuated, except by special things, as...
The things which are accepted are initiated gratefully; that is, are insinuated.
That he might thus insinuate the affection of good from truth. Signified, Explained.
Refusal to accept a present insinuates affection.
That the Reciprocal of affection might be insinuated. Signified, Explained.
That it was insinuated by the good of truth through affection inspired from Divine good. Signified, Explained.
The process itself of the insinuation of truth into good. Treated of. AC 4381.
A nurse = the insinuation of affection through the Celestial Spiritual.
Spirits... who had insinuated themselves among them...
Such is the insinuation with those who insidiate against marriage love.
Which are insinuated through the five external senses.
The truths which in the beginning are insinuated with man...
As truths from good are insinuated therein...
The affections of truth and good which have been insinuated from infancy...
There is insinuated by the Lord through an internal way the light of truth...
To prepare a present = insinuation.
Insinuation as much as possible. Signified.
They avert evil ends, and insinuate good ones.
To compel man is not to insinuate into his will... and therefore when he returns to his will... it is extirpated.
When evil Spirits pour in evils and falsities, the Angels insinuate truths and goods; and if these are not received, still they temper by means of them.
Unless truths are insinuated into scientifics...
The Scientific into which these truths are insinuated, is Pharaoh.
Insinuation into scientifics. Sig and Explained.
(Then) love with good is successively insinuated.
The regeneration of the Natural is effected by the insinuation of spiritual life by the Lord through the internal man into the scientifics there. This insinuation is treated of in this chapter.
He commanded them, and said to them insinuation. AC 6462.
To find grace in the eyes = a formula of insinuation.
(Thus) more truths and goods are insinuated.
The truth which is insinuated by the Lord with the man who is being regenerated, derives its origin from good.
A perception that good was to be insinuated into it by the Church itself. Signified, Explained. AC 6745. Signified.
For the milk which a nurse insinuates = the good of truth. Illustrated.
To suckle = to insinuate good. Illustrated.
To suck the milk of the gentiles = the insinuation of celestial good; the breasts of kings = the insinuation of celestial truth.
Good can be insinuated into another by anyone in the Country, but not truth, except by those who are teaching ministers...
Infestation is permitted to the end that falsities may be removed, and truths insinuated.
Evil Spirits excite falsities and evils; and the Angels excuse if the end has been good; and insinuate truths.
Unless the Lord insinuates the affection of spiritual truth...
The insinuation of good and truth... is effected by infestations and temptations...
Faith merely natural is faith which is insinuated through an external way.

But spiritual faith is that which is insinuated through an internal and at the same time an external way. The insinuation through the internal way causes it to be believed, and then its being insinuated through an external way causes it to be confirmed... The insinuation of faith through the internal way is effected by the reading of the Word...
When the good of charity is to be insinuated...
The insinuation of truth. Representation.
The truth of peace... insinuates itself into the truth which is below...
The insinuation of truth with man through the truth of peace. Signified, Explained.
The insinuation of life by the Lord with those who are being regenerated, is effected in successive order from Him...
When he desists from evil... in freedom, then is insinuated the affection of truth and good by the Lord.
The primary truths which are first insinuated by the Lord...
Enrichment in good is... insinuation into angelic Societies.
Temptations conduce... to insinuate (the truths of faith) into the Mill...
Then the Lord insinuates good into his life.
When the Lord is regenerating a man, He insinuates truth... into his Intellectual, and good... into his will...
For eternal life is insinuated when man is in freedom, and his reason is enlightened.
A Society into which many had insinuated themselves who...
Into the affections (of the infants) are first insinuated such things as appear before the eyes...
The World of Spirits appears like a valley... here and there winding into [the mountains and rocks], and elevated.
The inspiration or insinuation of love is... by the wives.
The thought is insinuated into them from Heaven...
If the Angels are being insinuated [into Heaven] they are to be called interior, more interior, and inmost.
Evil Spirits who insinuate themselves into Heaven...
(Whoremongers who) insinuate themselves (with virgins)... They also have the faculty to insinuate themselves into Societies...

He was an insinuator; for he was permitted to insinuate himself into some Societies of the interior Heaven; for he was accustomed to insinuations with married people... His insinuations were at the same time deceitful.
Such insinuate themselves into the affection of everyone...
Such Knowledges are thus insinuated...
They who can insinuate themselves with all in the world, and yet can think otherwise.
At the same time the faculty of choosing was insinuated into me.
They can insinuate themselves into any Society... SE 2496.
They are loved, because they can insinuate themselves into the passions of everyone...
Such... insinuate themselves more than others.
The vessels into which spiritual things, and into these celestial things, are insinuated; no one knowing when and how.
The things insinuated into man by the Lord... in Heaven have a wonderful connection.
They who in the life of the body... insinuate themselves by externals, in the other life have a sphere of sufficient efficacy to do the like...

Sirens are they who insinuate themselves into the cupidities, pleasures, and affections, in such a manner, that when they are in the state of insinuation they are unaware that evil or deceit is underneath... But those who, when they insinuate themselves, meditate about deceits, and thus... insinuate themselves with deliberate care for the sake of an evil end, are not Sirens, but are the deceitful.
That the persuasion cannot be insinuated except at intervals...
It was insinuated that these are they who... But it is now insinuated... SE 3224. SE 3408:end.
Then the Knowledges of faith are successively insinuated.
How he insinuated himself I did not perceive... because in the world he had thus insinuated himself...
For they insinuate themselves by means of good affections... SE 3720.
It was discovered from various things which were insinuated: by his insinuating adulteries...
It was insinuated to me that I should think about shame.
It was understood by the Angels, and was thus insinuated into my thought.
They draw out the interior thoughts of others by means of an insinuation that one should talk about one's delights...

I perceived that they insinuated themselves into the affections... They had derived this from the life in the body... thus insinuating themselves... They could thus insinuate themselves into Societies of the upright.
That celestial and spiritual things can be insinuated into (the vessels of the literal sense).
They who sat in the windings in of the cavern...
